title: Register a team member
summary: Front desk and administration. The role defines what they can see and do.

steps.title: New team member
steps.details: Opens the new team user form. The limit depends on your license.

steps.title: First and last name
steps.details: Name shown in the action history (who charged, who booked).

steps.title: Email
steps.details: It will be their username to sign in to Invoke. They get an email to choose their password.

steps.title: Role
steps.details: The role defines what they can see and do: Receptionist books and charges; Administrator also manages settings and reports.
steps.description: The front desk usually uses Receptionist; whoever handles the cash register and reports, Administrator.

steps.title: Create the user
steps.details: Creates the user with that role. Each role's permissions are adjusted in System → Roles.
